answer: A new agent must lock a ferrous collateral bond equal to one epoch of median rewards, frozen for four epochs and forfeitable. Peers mint only one marble identity token after that lock is on-ledger and a unique hardware-receipt hash is bound to it. If two tokens collide on a receipt or signing key, any peer posts a compact proof; the panel burns both bonds and writes those identities down to a nadir balance of zero, so each extra sybil costs a full frozen stake rather than a free clone.
